items.title: 43 名陆军成员重新入伍，以换取带薪休假玩 GTA 6
items.summary: If you’ve been following the GTA 6 hype train, you’ll probably remember the time that an army battalion went v

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/gta-6-spekulationen-beziehungssystem-1794933650291.jpg

If you’ve been following the GTA 6 hype train, you’ll probably remember the time that an army battalion went viral for offering service members four days of paid time off to play Rockstar's highly-anticipated game if they reenlisted.

The news became a hot topic after a flyer advertising the paid leave was first shared online back in August. Now that GTA 6 is almost upon us (or, in some regions, already out ), we’ve finally gotten an update on how many soldiers actually took up the battalion's offer.

The flyer, dated July 28, concerned the 9th Engineer Battalion in Fort Stewart, Georgia, and promised a “special reenlistment incentive” by giving eligible service members four days off to play the game from November 20 - 23, 2026. This was done specifically to “coincide with the highly anticipated release of the video game Grand Theft Auto VI,” with the goal of “promoting retention, boosting morale, and rewarding the continued dedication of the Soldiers within the 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion.”

Three months later, military-focused news outlet Task and Purpose has shared a follow-up on this incentive, confirming that 43 members of the battalion took up the offer. Two of these soldiers spoke with the platform — one being combat engineer Sgt. Jamire Smith, who says he signed up for the GTA 6-specific PTO and an additional six more years in the armed forces. However, this extra time came with a nice $60,000 bonus, owed to his special training learning how to drive heavy breaching vehicles.

“I’m all campaign. I’m all about the heist. I think I have a good 24 hours to waste on it,” he told the outlet. “I was actually in the process of getting out, I was towards my final stages of getting out … but my company and the battalion helped me navigate through that and they showed me that there’s still a need for me, and that I am still a clear and value asset to the team, and so that’s really what drove me to say ‘let’s keep going, let’s keep driving.’ Maybe be a lifer in this, since I already made it my career.”

Task and Purpose even got in touch with the person responsible for coming up with the campaign, Staff Sgt. Brittany Wolfer, a career counselor who explained why she chose to use the game as an eye-catching way to get soldiers to stay in the service.

“I brought it to my battalion commander and he’s a little bit older, but he did play GTA 2 at some point, so he was like, ‘Yeah I’m down for it,’” Wolfer explained. “I came into [the unit], there hadn’t been a counselor for about eight months, so there [were] a lot of gaps and things that were falling through, because the soldiers didn’t have that presence within the formation. This was just a way to grab people’s attention and kind of be like, ‘Hey, here I am. I’m the person you’re gonna come talk to,’ and [it] kind of snowballed from there.”

Wolfer made it clear that she knows the GTA 6-focused PTO dates won’t be a “deciding factor” in someone’s decision to reenlist, but said the idea was a way to “bridge that gap” between soldiers and their senior command “to where that lower soldier still knows that their battalion commander or their senior leadership cares about them and sees what they’re interested in. And that’s kind of what this was for.”

GTA 6 releases for players in the United States at 12am ET / 9pm PT. Despite not even being officially out yet, it has already scored eight nominations at the 2026 Game Awards , and is one of the highest-rated games in Metacritic history . You can check out our review for the game right here on IGN, which we scored a glowing 10 out of 10.

items.title: 别急着赚钱！《GTA6》5件最值得优先做的事
items.summary: 《GTA6》开始时会有一个简短的教程阶段，玩家可以短暂地扮演杰森·杜瓦尔和露西亚·卡米诺斯。不过，教程结束后，基本上就完全由玩家自由探索了，几乎可以去莱昂尼达的任何地方。只要你乘坐汽车或船只（扮演杰森时你拥有这两种交通工

content.v: 《GTA6》开始时会有一个简短的教程阶段，玩家可以短暂地扮演杰森·杜瓦尔和露西亚·卡米诺斯。不过，教程结束后，基本上就完全由玩家自由探索了，几乎可以去莱昂尼达的任何地方。只要你乘坐汽车或船只（扮演杰森时你拥有这两种交通工具），就可以自由前往地图上的任何地点，完成任何任务。
虽然你可以完全自由地做任何你想做的事情，但在《GTA6》中，有些事情你最好优先去做。无论是为了赚取额外金钱、让你在面对敌人时占得先机，还是为了让故事更加精彩，有些行动都应该优先于其他行动。下面，我们将为你列出在《GTA6》中应该优先做的五件事。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795042591_575252.webp
为你的武器购买消音器
首先，我们来说说经典的消音器。在《GTA6》中，消音器能让与敌人交战变得更加轻松，因为它几乎可以消除武器开火时的所有噪音。这让你在与敌人遭遇时拥有巨大的优势，你可以悄无声息地逐个击破敌人，而不是像以前那样，一开枪就引来附近所有敌人的围攻。
你可以前往“军火国度”商店购买大多数武器的消音器。完成新手教程后，你可以在基伦托直接找到一家很方便的商店，不过这种商店在莱昂尼达各地都很常见。消音器价格也不贵，所以你应该能在游戏一开始就买到至少一个。
买个车库停放你的车辆
车库在新版GTA系列中已不再是新鲜事物，GTA6提供了近十几个车库供玩家在主线剧情中购买。不过，你必须等到GTA 6中车库开放购买，也就是等到杰森和露西亚离开基伦托之后。当然，你也可以提前探索地图找到所有车库的位置，但车库价格不菲，你肯定希望把钱省下来购买其他物品。
不过，车库一旦开放购买，就应该优先考虑。车库不仅可以免费存放任何车辆（无论是偷来的还是自己拥有的），还能让你在车库里取用武器装备，并存放一些非法物品，让其他NPC帮你出售。车库非常实用，所以一开始就买一个绝对是一项明智的投资。
探索Key Lento
尽管很难抵挡住直接前往罪恶 都市 或其他区域的诱惑，但《GTA6》的开篇却是在基伦托，而且显然希望玩家在游戏的前半部分都待在那里。故事的前20%的所有任务都发生在这里，虽然这听起来有些局限，但基伦托本身就有很多值得探索和体验的地方。
你可以沿着主街一路走走，与形形色色的有趣人物互动，包括你的邻居雪莉，以及一位骑着电动滑板车的脾气暴躁的老妇人。基伦托还有几处精心打造的室内场景可供参观，例如锈锚酒吧和厚脸皮叛逆者酒吧，后者尤其拥有令人惊艳的户外氛围。虽然你并非必须探索这些地方，完全可以留在基伦托，但这个小小的初始区域在《GTA 6》中绝对值得一游。
别担心赚钱的事。
虽然这与其说是“应该”，不如说是“不应该”，但在《GTA6》初期担心钱财几乎是徒劳的。我们不会剧透具体内容，但你手头的钱在游戏前30%的流程中很快就会用完。在后续任务中，杰森和露西亚的银行账户都会被掏空，而你对此却无能为力。
所以，考虑到这一点，你仍然需要赚钱来满足一些即时需求，比如购买武器或改装车辆。然而，如果你试图通过向唐尼或布莱恩出售非法物品来尽可能多地赚钱，你最终可能会发现这是在浪费时间，而且在《GTA6》的早期阶段还有更好的消遣方式。
参与所有相关内容

最后，我们最重要的建议是：不要错过基伦托（Key Lento）出现的任何支线活动。这些支线内容不仅精彩有趣，而且如果你把它们留到《GTA6》后期再玩，你可能会后悔。随着主线剧情的推进，你会前往新的区域，很快就会发现返回莱昂尼达群岛（Leonida Keys）并非易事。开车过去可能需要十分钟以上，当你意识到这一点时，你可能会觉得支线内容不值得花费这么多时间。然而，《GTA 6》一开始你就身处莱昂尼达群岛，所以最好在有空的时候完成那里所有可用的支线内容。
游戏中一些最精彩的支线活动都发生在基伦托。从肯顿的水下寻宝之旅，到和卡尔一起钓鱼，再到接受邻居雪莉的各种奇葩委托，只要你接受任何任务，在基伦托绝对不会感到无聊。

items.title: 将移相器设置为眩晕（我钱包里的东西）：《Magic》的《星际迷航》联动是最好的之一
items.summary: Magic: The Gathering's Universes Beyond line goes beyond the final frontier.

content.v: I recruited the biggest Star Trek fan I know to help me road test the new Magic: The Gathering set. Right away he was impressed by cards that referenced the Star Trek: Prodigy cartoon and Star Trek Beyond—a third movie in the J. J. Abrams-verse I completely forgot was even made—but if that kind of trainspotting was all it took to make a successful crossover then people would have liked the Spider-Man cards a lot more than they did.

What makes the better Universes Beyond crossovers work is how they bring out the themes of their source material, turning motifs into mechanics that make a set feel like a genuine expression of the thing being adapted rather than just another property being fed into the content machine. Having played some games with the cards, yeah, I think Star Trek works.

I built a blue-green deck around Strange New Worlds , a mechanic that rewards you for having different lands rather than just stacking Islands and Forests. When I played Deep Space Scan I drew a card for each differently named land I had, and those lands also lowered the cost of powering up my Astute Terraformer.

Meanwhile, the Federation mechanic gives bonuses for having different creature types on the table like Vulcan and Klingon and Romulan (though not Borg). With just those two mechanics, the set emphasizes exploration and diversity. You really do want to put together a crew representing multiple species and send them into the final frontier. (There is of course a card called Final Frontier.)
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dSYUPQcz2qUcFnniGNbnNc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FKVLHF2WHcjC5sHM95QkNc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Jmd73EbNeLWAZDUC8unFRc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v6FE2m7845TidzBGH5qtLc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Jd3CHJpsquHkZMeyoAfPLc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zsZCWToXpfvQ9kEAnW3wJc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/V2563Exvp9xAxSnhXnsaKc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aik3C2WWnYZccxkpcYNRJc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KUcx7BFHBoULSToeAqJ3Cc-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5vYqBiKVZpeJuVCLoeGJ6c-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dLkbNWfEvADv32VwaPnJwb-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Ys3TMsgo7k37DM2bxaaG4c-1920-80.jpg

Star Trek also makes use of the spacecraft mechanics introduced in Edge of Eternities, where a ship starts with limited capabilities but has to be stationed by tapping creatures to add charge counters to access its full abilities—like flying and fighting. Lt. Cmdr. Geordi La Forge is a solid combo, doubling the amount of charge counters you add each time and letting you get the Enterprise into the air twice as fast.

There are cards for various different iterations of the Enterprise, but I'm partial to U.S.S. Enterprise-A, Free Spirit, because when you play it you get three red 1/1 officer tokens for free. That makes it faster to station, and after that you've got three disposable officers to chump block with. Which is why they're red .

There's also a Beam Me Up mechanic to bring a card back from the discard pile at the cost of returning a card from the table to your hand, and a cute assimilate mechanic that lets you wipe creatures' existing types then turn them into artifacts under your control for your Borg deck. But what makes the Star Trek cards feel like Star Trek is how much they emphasize teamwork.

The Common Goal card lets two creatures deal damage together, and there's a whole suite of cards that get better when you've got creatures with a total power of 8 attacking as one. Worf, Honor-Bound Warrior, who doubles his own power when he's part of that attack, proved a gamewinner for my red/white deck more than once. The thing that really comes across is Star Trek's utopian ideal of everyone pulling together in a crisis and being better for our differences. It's optimistic, with stars in its eyes, and even a casual Star Trek watcher like me can appreciate that.
Magic: The Gathering's Star Trek set is available now, for both tabletop Magic and Arena.

items.title: GTA 6：在哪里可以立即找到您的第一架飞机和直升机
items.summary: Steal your first aircraft close to your GTA 6 starting point.

content.v: If you've just started GTA 6 you might be wondering where the nearest airplane and helicopter are located to your starting point. There's a huge new world to explore, and the best way to do it is by air. But first, you've got to find a plane or chopper to steal.
Luckily, there's a reliable spot to snag your first few aircraft close to your starting safehouse, and you can probably steal them without raising a single alarm.
Where to find your first airplane

You'll drive about 2.5 miles southwest from Jason's house in Key Lento. Start the trip by driving southwest through Key Lento , then west through Abismo Key , and finally west and then north to Southwind .

You'll be taking Sunbelt Highway (Route 1) the whole way and you'll know you're close after you cross two long bridges . Southwind is a small district located next to the Mile Zero Air Station: GTA 6's military base.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eE6UTwfWobMrcYB5SkSY8M-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/djvwep9PzqimeeeKiZUDAM-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2iPfaLirkUDjG72aXR7y7M-1920-80.jpg
(Yes, the military base has planes and helicopters too, but it's a little trickier getting your hands on them so check out our GTA 6 military base guide before you attempt it.)

The highway will make a bend to the north as you enter Southwind. On your right you'll see a concrete barrier alongside the road, and where it ends is where you want to turn right into the parking lot , at the sign for SBW (Sherwin Boatworks) and Chicki's Tiki Bar.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/m7UUXDruAGqPvKFhjRKSGM-1920-80.jpg

If you're facing the water (east), on your right (to the south) is a small hangar with (typically) a few Mammoth Dodo seaplanes parked inside and around it, and often a couple more moored off the dock. Seaplanes aren't the fastest planes in the game, but they're perfect for early exploration because they can land on both water and land, and they require almost no room to get airborne.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PWzFYzK5Mw8FyDg5W5VaJM-1920-80.jpg
There's never anyone hanging around here, either, so you won't draw any attention if you help yourself to one of these planes. Just drive one into the water and take off, or steal one from the dock.
Where to find your first helicopter

Follow the same instructions to Southwind as above, but instead of looking to the south, look straight east from the entrance to the parking lot . There's an open gate leading out to a dock where a Buckingham Maverick helicopter is sitting.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KJxApM6ZSj3BjW4WLBWrEM-1920-80.jpg
Just ignore the no trespassing sign, run over to the dock, and hop into it. Now the skies are yours.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA-1920-80.jpg

items.title: Clair Obscur：《Expedition 33》首席编剧去年夏天离开 Sandfall Interactive：“我们已经分道扬镳了”
items.summary: Jennifer Svedberg-Yen says she left the studio in July after finishing up work on the studio's hit RPG.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/03/13/clairthumb-1741875039872.png

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ’s lead writer has left Sandfall to help other game developers think about story from the outset. Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, the narrative lead for Expedition 33, won a BAFTA Breakthrough U.S. award earlier this year, and she’s since been consulting on stories across the industry.

Expedition 33 was her first video game (she came from a career in private equity), but it won more than 400 awards and received almost universal critical acclaim, in part due to its blend of real-time and traditional turn-based RPG mechanics, and partly because of its mysterious story, strong emotional beats, and brilliant characters.
Svedberg-Yen is now setting up a fund with the aim of advancing narrative design in video games and nurturing new writing talent.

“I feel that we are losing so much institutional knowledge,” Svedberg-Yen told GamesBeat . “We’re making it extraordinarily difficult for a younger generation of developers to have formative experiences. There’s so much disruption in the industry right now.”
Outside of the constant layoffs and upheaval in the industry, there’s also a sense, still, that narrative isn’t as respected as other parts of game design.
“A lot of studios think of narrative as a skin,” Svedberg-Yen said. “They think you can bring someone in later to make everything make sense.
“But when you start from the beginning, everyone is building from the same story and the different disciplines naturally reinforce each other.”

The award-winning writer believes this approach limits what games can achieve. Expedition 33 was designed with a narrative-first approach, with the game systems built around the story to reinforce the themes and pace the big moments out.

“Narrative was king,” she said. “It was always a narrative-first game. I think that’s why we were able to achieve the results that we did in terms of integrating all the different pieces into a wonderful collaborative whole. There was that consistency from the very beginning.”
According to Svedberg-Yen, she’s received messages from players about how Expedition 33 helped them deal with grief and navigate the world after suffering a personal loss.

Unfortunately, it doesn’t seem like we’ll see more of Svedberg-Yen’s work in video games any time soon. Outside of the fund, she has a couple of ideas for TV, but she left Sandfall in July “after wrapping up some final stuff for Expedition.”

Following success at pretty much every major video game award show (most recently including scooping up Best Game at the BAFTA Awards ), Sandfall Interactive is now busy planning its next project. Details of that currently remain under wraps, though the suggestion is that it will be another adventure set in the same Clair Obscur universe .

"Wearing its inspirations on its sleeve, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 paints itself into the pantheon of great RPGs with a brilliant combat system and a gripping, harrowing story," IGN wrote in our Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 review , dubbing it a "modern RPG classic."

items.title: Devolver 不仅与 GTA 6 在同一天发布游戏，还使用了 GTA 6 发布预告片的逐个镜头重制版
items.summary: Ever see cartoon rodents get it on in the shower? Do you want to?

content.v: While most game studios are carefully avoiding the Grand Theft Auto 6 behemoth, Devolver Digital has relentlessly and theatrically pursued it. In May 2025 it pledged to launch a game on May 26, head-to-head with GTA 6—and when GTA 6 was delayed, Devolver delayed too .

And now, with GTA 6 slowly rolling through its official launch on November 19, it's finally (almost) here: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, "a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous videogame mascot of all time," developed by Gunbrella/Gato Roboto studio Doinksoft.

So, first things first: As the word "unreleased" amidst that slurry of words from the Steam page suggests, this is not actually a remake of a popular game from the days of yore, although it certainly has the vibe , and actually looks pretty decent as these things go. And yes, Volvy is indeed Devolver's mascot—here's some massively overpriced merchandise , if you're into that, or just want evidence.

"Adventure across four revamped worlds full of naughty baddies and menacing boss fights while collecting delicious onions to keep Volvy at extreme levels of awesome," Devolver said of the game. "There's some sort of story too. Basically some warlocks released some slime and Volvy is stopping them. Also, they kidnapped his friends."

What really brings us here, though, is that dogged pursuit of GTA 6. It's obviously coattails marketing, but as PC Gamer's Shaun Prescott said in 2025, it's a pretty good bit—and Devolver is really sticking with it.
Yes indeed, the Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed launch trailer is a virtual shot-for-shot remake of the GTA 6 launch trailer, music and all.
Here's the GTA 6 take, so you can judge for yourself just how close it comes:
That is a pretty good bit, alright.

Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed will set you back $5 on Steam when it goes live on November 19. But the shenanigans aren't quite over yet: Devolver is also offering "a chance" at a free copy of the game to anyone who sends a video showing them deleting their GTA 6 preload, and streaming "the tunes of Devolver’s storied history" on "KVOLE Devolvy Digital radio" on YouTube . I'm listening now—it's actually pretty good.

items.title: 当我对着我的 5090 微笑时，Rockstar 表示 PS5 Pro 对于 60 fps 的 GTA 6 来说“不够强大”
items.summary: The consoles just aren't up to the task.

content.v: If I can pinpoint one disappointing aspect of GTA 6 that most will agree on, it's the fact that it runs at 30 fps.

Many of us remember when this was normal for consoles (especially the PS3/Xbox 360 era), but these days, it's unusual for a major game to not offer a 60 fps or 40 fps performance option. Unfortunately, even if you're rocking a PS5 Pro, GTA 6 moves at a filmic 30.

That's disappointing news for anyone who shelled out $900+ for the more powerful PS5 Pro expecting better performance (or vindicating news, if you're a PC Gamer reader waiting for the arbitrarily delayed PC version), but Rockstar insists there was no way around it.
Speaking to Kotaku , technology production director Marc Chambers explained that the current consoles just aren't powerful enough to keep up without significant compromises.

"Our base presentation makes use of ray-traced reflections and global illumination. On the PS5 Pro, this is enhanced with the addition of ray-traced shadows, as well as overall added clarity through the use of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR)," he said. "The PS5 Pro features an upgraded graphics processor and upscaling technology that we leverage to increase the game’s visual fidelity. While the PS5 Pro’s central processor is slightly better than the PS5 base console, it is not powerful enough to run the game’s complex simulation at higher frame rates."
Head of development Rob Nelson framed the decision to skip performance mode in much simpler terms to IGN :

"It wouldn’t have been acceptable to anybody. The simple answer is, when you ask the technical team, they’re, like, ‘Have you seen it?’ There’s too many compromises that would’ve had to have been made to do that, is the short answer," he said. "Too much, too much."

While I don't actually have a problem playing a slow-paced game like GTA 6 at half the usual framerate so long as it's consistent and smooth, I can't deny that these quotes left me cracking a smile in the direction of my PC.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UdvPTt9yoAQQC52GZNGfXK-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cJzBTfpfhiEthMEfnToL5D-1920-80.jpg

The world of Leonida does look unbelievably impressive at times—both in terms of pure graphical oomph and the density of vehicles, NPCs, and reactive foliage—but a great PC is going to demolish it. I've been searching for a game that will make this RTX 5090 actually flinch, and honestly, I'm doubtful even GTA 6 will be it. Barring a suite of PC-only enhancements that raise its requirements by a lot, I can't imagine a game that targets an Xbox Series S will have trouble blowing past 60 fps on top PC hardware.

This is putting into perspective for me that, while I wasn't looking, the current consoles got old. That's fine, to be clear—we're in the middle of a tech pause that has me happily playing older games anyway—but it's a wasted opportunity that GTA 6 is debuting exclusively on mid hardware.

We have to wait an unspecified amount of time to get what is destined to be the best version of this generational game. As Chris said in his writeup after 100 hours with GTA 6 , "It's (mostly) great. But it will be (mostly) so much greater when it comes to PC."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 迷惑的日本玩家与《GTA 6》控制系统战斗，失败了，变成了“那个家伙在蹲着走动时不小心买了两杯奶昔”
items.summary: No matter how much money you spend, players will find a way to make your game look doofy.

content.v: It's here. GTA 6 has been loosed upon the world, and another nation's productivity goes dark as each advancing hour unleashes midnight unlocks on the next timezone. And hey, from the sounds of it, people seem to like what they're finding —and they're finding a lot.

You can mini-golf. You can go on beach dates. You can text and drive (don't). You can doomscroll, and birdwatch, and ride a jetski with a dog . GTA 6 is dense with possible activities, actions, systems, and mechanics, but not everyone is having the best luck navigating the maelstrom of associated controls and button prompts. Allow me to present Japanese X user @Shunep3_STS , who on this day represents all of us:
操作が増えて覚えきれず、間違えて２つ買ったシェイクをしゃがみ歩きしながら飲み干すヤバい奴になってる https://t.co/OLXaEQGc7C November 18, 2026

"There are so many new controls I can’t keep them all straight," said @Shunep3_STS via machine translation, "and now I’m that guy chugging two shakes I accidentally bought while walking around in a squat."

There's something magical about this image. To begin with, the scene—like all of GTA 6—looks profoundly, almost grotesquely expensive : the delicate feathering of Jason's forearm hair, the pseudo-memoji of Cal in the text message notification, the fidelity of pebbled sand that probably cost more to realize in-game than I've spent on rent in the last three years. It's a tableau of technological excess.

And all of that's being deployed to present a man double-fisting slushies in an empty parking lot as he skulks like an imperiled raccoon. Look at him! Look at his face! He's got his chiseled jaw set like he's Solid Snake, but he's nursing a tummy full of iced corn syrup because the pilot controlling his body got too overwhelmed by which buttons do what.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s28WSVfTT9RYhD2RwAZJVg-1920-80.png

And he's not alone: Our own Andrea Shearon is one of the many struggling to keep up with the sheer volume of button prompts in GTA 6. "There's so much going on," she said. "I just walk up to people and kind of mash all the face buttons for a surprise. You never know if I'm gonna punch someone or do squats or flip them off."
She's spent a lot of time accidentally making rude gestures at her snake as a result.

Amidst all the breathless praise, clips of psychopathic violence, reactionary outrage-mongering, and general noise coming out of GTA 6's launch, @Shunep3_STS's moment of shame feels very pure. It's a universal experience: No matter how much a game is hyped up, no matter how much money is spent on making it look as impressive as humanly and technologically possible, no matter how much we might want it to, we all inevitably find a way to fumble the controls so badly that the illusion entirely breaks down.
We're all, at some point, a man huddling in the dark, trying to figure out how to put down his sippy cups.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4UAoyCLM246CLeZy7wBXb-1920-80.jpg

content.v: 围绕《塞尔达传说》电影的评论认为，改编面临的核心难题并非还原大师之剑、三角力量或海拉鲁，而是如何确定林克在银幕上的人物形象，同时保留这名沉默主角留给玩家的投射空间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795037937_161226_jpg_r.jpg
游戏中的林克长期保持寡言，玩家可以在操控过程中把自己的反应、决定和性格理解投射到角色身上。电影观众无法通过控制角色建立同样的联系，只能观看创作者确定的林克。评论指出，观看约两小时电影与亲自操控数十小时并不相同，演员和观众都需要足够的情感线索。
让林克完全沉默，表面上可能更接近游戏；但若为了传统商业电影的节奏，让他频繁说俏皮话，又可能破坏角色最重要的安静气质。电影需要在两者之间找到适合银幕的表达方式。
评论以《塞尔达传说：时之笛》《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》和《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》为例，认为系列已经通过行动、表情、回忆和日记，表现林克的勇气与可靠，也呈现了他在与塞尔达关系中承受的压力。
因此，电影可以通过肢体表演、克制的对白和具体动机塑造林克，不必让他不断解释自己的感受。评论最终认为，改编需要为游戏中的沉默互动体验找到电影化替代方式，而非把林克直接套进常规动作片主角模板。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》规模庞大：迄今为止，玩家已创造了超过 1500 万个角色
items.summary: Blizzard has called it "the biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players."

content.v: Even though Grand Theft Auto 6 will be taking over the world tomorrow, World of Warcraft: Forever was the first game this month that people flocked to in record-breaking numbers.

While we don't know the exact player count like we do with games on Steam, we can make an educated guess on just how many people dove into the MMO via a recent set of statistics from Blizzard. According to the official WoW X account , over 15 million characters were created in the last few weeks.

Characters aren't individual players. You can create dozens of characters on your account if you want to, but I'd guess most people didn't do that. This is a game where you can put hundreds of hours into one character before ever reaching the level cap. There definitely aren't 15 million total players based on this statistic, but the number might not be massively below that.

That's a big deal for WoW, an MMO that hasn't boasted numbers like that since 2010 at the height of the Wrath of the Lich King expansion, when it had over 12 million active subscribers . Blizzard stopped posting exact numbers after that, so it's possible later expansions went higher, but it certainly seems like WoW: Forever has eclipsed the last several years of modern WoW. Blizzard even called it "the biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players," a few days after its debut.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mWaWGrJUELGA2Ww2C9abBF-1920-80.png

I can't say I'm surprised that a spin-off MMO that will remain stuck in the most universally nostalgic era of WoW was a big hit. Everyone who stopped playing for one reason or another came back to remember what it was like to smack a scorpion for 38 seconds .

Whether or not they'll stick around is the question. Blizzard plans on updating the game with new things to do for players at different stages of the long leveling journey. Most people are still weeks away from reaching the level 60 cap, partially because there are so many things to do that don't involve XP. The first raid is around the corner, but I'm curious to see what kind of stuff is added for those of us who are still chilling in the mid-30s. It'd better be good because many of us will be on vacation in Leonida for the next several weeks.

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》的DMZ模式据称已调整匹配逻辑，组建对局时将更加重视玩家技术水平。Infinity Ward尚未正式公布这项变化。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795036922_237812_jpg_r.jpg
CharlieIntel及其知情来源称，Infinity Ward近期实施了这项调整。不过，开发团队没有披露技术因素在首发阶段及调整后的具体占比，也未说明延迟、地理位置等其他匹配条件是否发生变化。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795036923_249246_jpg_r.jpg
理论上，提高水平权重可能减少新手队伍遭遇资深玩家的情况，同时让高水平玩家更频繁地面对实力相近的队伍。由于DMZ玩家需要争夺高价值区域并成功撤离才能保住所获物资，这项变化带来的差异可能更加明显。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795036924_212898_jpg_r.jpg
匹配等待时间也受到关注。主播JGOD曾展示一次等待超过6分钟才进入对局的情况，但单次经历不足以证明排队时间变长与此次调整有关。技术匹配自测试阶段以来一直存在争议，目前玩家实际体验会有多大变化仍无法确定，这项调整也尚未出现在Infinity Ward正式发布的更新说明中。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《GTA6》媒体评价公开，报道所列Metascore达到99分。多名参与开发的Rockstar成员随后在社交平台分享感受，庆祝游戏正式推出并获得良好反响。

GamesRadar+在自家评测中将《GTA6》称为“世代级成就”，认为其 开放世界 在规模、范围和质量上表现突出，系列玩法的各个方面也较过去作品有所改进。

content.v: 美国田纳西州共和党众议员蒂姆·伯切特在《GTA6》发售前夕公开批评该作，称其如同教授犯罪的“操作视频”。他还认为，游戏中的 暴力 内容会让儿童对现实暴力逐渐麻木。

伯切特表示，家长应当承担管教责任。记者追问，允许孩子游玩《GTA6》是否意味着家长“不称职”，伯切特给出了肯定回答。不过，他也承认自己几乎无法阻止儿童接触这款游戏，并抱怨美国国会缺少通过立法干预道德问题的意愿。
关于电子游戏暴力会引发现实暴力的说法，目前缺乏研究支持，多项研究总体上没有发现两者存在关联。因此，伯切特有关游戏暴力影响儿童的主张并未形成新的共识。
类似争议在该系列历史上并非首次出现。2004年《GTA：圣安地列斯》曾因通常无法访问的性场景引发国际争论，游戏评级一度被调整为“仅限成人”。如今《GTA6》包含裸体和性内容，却未引发同等规模的争议，此次表态更接近美国政界过去围绕电子游戏暴力展开的论战回潮。

items.summary: Got some burning questions for someone who's already spent 100 hours in GTA 6? Drop queries in the comments an

content.v: I've been secretly playing Grand Theft Auto 6 for the past several weeks and my suffering is finally at an end.

Not that I suffered from playing GTA 6! I had a blast, actually, and as I laid out in my not-a-review this morning, I really like the game. In fact, after putting in about 100 hours, I'm ready for 100 more, though I desperately wish the game were on PC.
You know, the way it should be. The way it's meant to be.

No, my suffering is that for the past two weeks I haven't been able to talk about GTA 6 with anyone, so I'm positively bursting to let a few things fly. With that in mind, here's my invitation to you:

Ask me anything! In the comments below, ask me whatever burning questions you might have about GTA 6. I'm gonna be at my desk all day (and most of the night, probably), so I'll answer them as promptly as I can.

I don't mean ask stuff like "how does it end" or anything that could be considered a major spoiler, but stuff about how Jason and Lucia's relationship works, the activities, the characters, the world, the systems, and honestly, any other questions you might have about the game. I'll be checking the comments section for the next few days and on Friday we'll (probably) turn your questions and my answers into a story for the site.

items.summary: A lot of people are upset that they can't get GTA 6 on a physical disc, and KFC is now stepping up to do what

content.v: A lot of people are upset that they can't get GTA 6 on a physical disc, and KFC is now stepping up to do what Rockstar isn't.

KFC Spain has announced a "Replace the Disc" campaign where customers can get a free disc-shaped piece of fried chicken when they bring in their GTA 6 box. The promotion takes place December 19 and 20 from 4 to 8 PM at KFC locations in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and others in the country.

GTA 6 is sold at retailers like Best Buy, GameStop, and Target, but the box doesn't include a disc--instead, you get a code to unlock the game. GTA 6 owner Take-Two recently reported that 98% of its sales were digital, and while there will be some physical aspects to gaming forever, it's an increasingly small part of the business , Take-Two's boss has said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/chickendisc-1.png?w=636

This is not KFC's only promotion for GTA 6. KFC Australia is holding a fake funeral for a person named "Ann Alibi" in Australia's version of Miami on November 19. The fake funeral services are taking place in the middle of the day, per Ann's wishes, and so that people can have a "legitimate" reason to take the day off.

Numerous brands are latching onto GTA 6 to leverage the enormity of the game's release to promote their own stuff. McDonald's, for example, just announced a campaign to get your McNuggets or Big Mac delivered while you keep playing GTA 6. Even smaller, more regional brands-- including the Massachusetts-based brewery Tree House --have announced GTA 6 promos.

GTA 6 officially launches for everyone on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. For now, you can read GameSpot's GTA 6 review and check out our GTA 6 guides hub for more details on how to make the most out of your trip to Vice City

items.title: Xbox 的 GTA 6 流媒体交易如何将其市场份额扩大 30%
items.summary: Microsoft and Take-Two recently announced a deal to allow people to stream Rockstar's GTA 6 , and that signifi

content.v: Microsoft and Take-Two recently announced a deal to allow people to stream Rockstar's GTA 6 , and that significantly increases the game's addressable market on Xbox and means people can play the game for as little as $92.

This is according to a newly issued report from Ampere Analysis , which said the streaming deal could reach the estimated 10 million "active" Xbox One consoles out there and expand the total addressable market for GTA 6 on Xbox by 30%.
For anyone just catching up, Microsoft worked out a deal with Take-Two to allow GTA 6 to be streamed to an Xbox console--that could be an Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, or even an Xbox One.

There are some key things to know, including how the game streams from an Xbox Series S version of the game and your streaming experience will depend on the strength and consistency of your connection. A report from Digital Foundry said the Xbox Series S edition of GTA 6 struggles with its frame rate at some points, but that might not be an issue for everyone.

No such arrangement is in place for PlayStation, so the only way to stream GTA 6, at least right now, is on Xbox. Ampere said there are about 25 million PS4 consoles in the market that are still active, while Sony is the market leader for current-generation consoles with the PS5.

Why do a deal with Microsoft and not Sony? Ampere said Take-Two was likely interested in the potential expanded reach with Xbox to help sell more units, but there might have also been a "direct payment" or a revenue-share agreement on Xbox that was more preferential to Take-Two. Ampere said Take-Two wants the PS4 audience as well via streaming, but that might not happen until 2027 at the soonest, if such a deal ever materializes at all.

Beyond this, Ampere said there could be "technology-based reasons" why Sony didn't get a deal done for GTA 6 streaming. The research firm pointed out how Microsoft is a "hyperscaler" when it comes to streaming via its vast Azure network, which "puts it in a stronger position to serve a large influx of users streaming a brand-new game like GTA 6 compared to Sony."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Grand-Theft-Auto-VI_20261103112343-1.jpg?w=636

"The favorable distribution costs to Microsoft as the service provider and owner of the cloud infrastructure also gives it a commercial advantage," Ampere said. "While PS5 users can generally stream their owned games as long as they have an active PS Plus Premium subscription, PS4 users don’t have that functionality. Essentially, Sony is not set up to offer its PS4 users the same streaming experience."

Beyond all this, Ampere highlighted how PS5 users ($731) are spending more than PS4 users ($580) over the same lifecycle stage of each console. "Converting users to PS5 is more important to Sony than adding some sales of GTA 6 or PS4 users," Ampere said.
Under $100 to play GTA 6 on Xbox

Xbox's streaming deal for GTA 6 also makes Xbox the most affordable place to play GTA 6. Ampere said the total cost to play on Xbox could be $92, assuming the player already has an Xbox One, a copy of GTA 6, a controller, and a screen.
Ampere did the math by estimating the cost to be 0.24 cents per hour to stream the game, for a total of $92 via streaming, assuming a 50-hour runtime for the game.

This rate leaves little margin for Xbox, Ampere said, but the fact that people have to buy streaming time up front means there will no doubt be "a significant amount of playtime languishing in accounts that is never used."
As announced previously, people can stream GTA 6 to their Xbox console via a Game Pass membership or by purchasing time without a Game Pass membership. The pricing is below.
Cloud playtime packs pricing:
Coinciding with GTA 6's release and the new streaming deal, Microsoft just instituted limits on how many hours members can stream before being asked to pay more. These are:
Even beyond the streaming deal, Xbox is the most affordable place to play GTA 6 considering that a new Xbox Series S console costs $500, compared to $600 for the cheapest new PS5.

GTA 6 officially launches for everyone on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Meanwhile, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub for more details on how to make the most out of your trip to Vice City.

items.title: GTA 6 改变了您偷车的方式：以下是您需要了解的有关 slim jims、钥匙克隆器和跟踪设备的所有信息
items.summary: Cars have gotten smarter, but so have you.

content.v: Used to be that all you needed to steal a car in a GTA game was a few seconds and a sharp elbow. In GTA 6 , you can still smash a window and hotwire some cars, but the car stealing system has changed a lot and the further you get into the game, the more tools you'll need.

That means a quick getaway in a stolen vehicle isn't always that simple. Here are the methods for stealing cars, the new tools you'll get and when they become available in the story, and everything else you need to know about boosting rides in GTA 6.
Breaking into cars
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EJZcYu2qkvfPsHo6io4maK-1920-80.jpg

Want to steal a car? Walk up to the door and press the interact button. That'll tell you if it's locked (most are), if it's alarmed (nearly all are), and if it's keyless—a new type of car that we'll cover more below.

If you smash the window, you'll then climb into the car and need to hotwire it, which just takes a second or two and uses the control sticks to find the "sweet spot." If it's a keyless car, you won't be able to hotwire it or drive it away—again, more on that below. If you smash a window on an alarmed car, the alarm will sound, which can attract attention.
Carjacking

You can still pull people out of their cars, but be warned: many of them will fight back, meaning you'll need to hammer a button quickly to defeat them. Lose, and they'll clonk your head against the side of the car, knocking you down and speeding away. And even if you do pull them out of their car, this is Leonida: a lot of motorists are armed and aren't shy about opening fire.
You can't slim jim a car someone is already sitting in, so you'll have to break the window if the door is locked. Plus, there are car trackers to worry about now: more on that below.
Waink It app
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ha3RKwkppKYpb3bzDVmvjK-1920-80.jpg

In Chapter 1 , in the sixth story mission called Unwanted Attention , your buddy Cal will help you install the "Waink It" app on your phone, which lets you scan cars to see their make and model, if they're locked, alarmed, keyless, or have trackers. The app will also tell you the condition of the car, how much it can be sold for, and what it costs to register them—registering stolen cars at Pay 'n' Spray shops is how you take ownership of them in GTA 6.
Slim jim
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UdvPTt9yoAQQC52GZNGfXK-1920-80.jpg
Want to get into a locked car without breaking the window or setting off the alarm? You'll need a slim jim , a tool that lets you pop the lock and open the door quietly.

You'll get this new tool in Chapter 2 of the main story, in the fifth mission called "Moses," where you meet an auto mechanic (Moses!) who will give you a slim jim and teach you how to use it. Now when you sidle up to a car door, you'll be able to use the slim jim to pop the lock: no broken windows, no alarms—though it takes a little longer than using your elbow. Again, you still won't be able to start keyless cars, even if you have a slim jim.
Keyless cars and the key cloner
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ShAiWoRgbscJdznUZ4PuhK-1920-80.jpg

Here's the big one. Keyless cars can't be hotwired, so you'll need a key cloner . You'll get the key cloner in Chapter 3, in the 16th mission called "Steal the Zorruso for Randy." That's a long time to wait, but now you can stand next to the door of a keyless car and use your phone to clone its key.
Bonus: the key cloner will not only unlock the door but automatically start the car. That makes it worth the wait! However, keyless cars often come with another new system: trackers.
Trackers
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VUdJjYF72T2b2zkpjxYhgK-1920-80.jpg
Standard trackers

Not a big deal, really: if a car has a standard tracker, it just means you can't modify it at a mod shop unless you've paid to register the car as your own. I probably wouldn't modify a car unless I owned it anyway, so I never worried about standard trackers at all.
Advanced trackers

These can be a problem. Advanced trackers will notify the police that the car has been stolen and pinpoint your location—and the cops will respond quickly. To defeat the advanced tracker, you need to drive fast enough that the tracker won't be able to send a signal to the cops. Slow down, and it'll start beeping and you'll only have a few seconds to speed up again. If you fail to speed up enough, the tracker will pinpoint your location and the cops will be on you again.

You have to drive pretty fast to keep the advanced tracker from triggering, which makes it tougher to get them to a Pay 'n' Spray or a Randy's garage without doing some serious damage to the car. Good luck!
Selling and storage

You can sell stolen cars at a Pay 'n' Spray, though there's a limit of three cars per day. You can also sell to your two automobile fences , Moses and Randy, though Moses only buys older model, low-end cars and Randy only buys certain flashy, expensive cars. Your Waink It app will tell you if a car is suitable for sale to either of them.

You can also store stolen cars at a garage if you've purchased one through the real estate app on your phone. Each garage only has room for a single car. You can also use a parking spot or spots outside your current safehouse to store a stolen car.

items.title: Embark Studios 为在现已删除的总决赛视频中用人工智能语音替换电子竞技解说员而道歉
items.summary: The studio pulled the video after a wave of complaints and said replacing the casters who actually worked the

content.v: Following a backlash from casters and esports fans, Embark Studios has taken down a recap video from a recent esports tournament for The Finals that replaced the original casters' voices with AI.

The commentators for the APAC Closed Qualifiers for The Grand Major , the annual championship tournament for Embark's team-based FPS, were human. But, as reported by IGN , a highlight video released by Embark built from clips from the qualifier replaced those casters with audio from the game's AI commentators, Scotty and June.

It did not go over well. "After 4 cycles, open/closed quals, the time, effort, passion and emotion myself @TheeHyperactive and @bluepanda_casts put in," The Finals caster ProtoANZ wrote on X . "We get replaced by two AI casters who even quote us :/ I get they are apart of the game but yikes. Thanks @reachthefinals."

Reposting ProtoANZ's message, Bluepanda added , "For nearly 7 years I've been repeatedly told that my work is valued and appreciated only to then have the same people saying those things turn around and either completely ghost me or tell me they're going in a different direction with talent and that my services aren't needed GG."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6pqqjHxjtvgHXT3ZkV3uqD-1920-80.png

Other casters soon weighed in to express support for ProtoANZ and Bluepanda: League of Legends caster Sam "Initialise" Hapgood called it "dystopian," while Jen "LemonKiwi" Pichette described it as "appalling" and said "REAL casters deserve better."

Embark's relationship with AI in game development has always been messy. It recently announced a new "dynamic commentary" feature for The Finals that enables Scotty and June, the game's AI commentators, to call out specific gameplay events and individual player names, and earlier this month it defended the use of AI voices in Arc Raiders, saying it was "too impractical to record every possible version" of in-game items because the voice actors—people who literally make their living reading scripts—"would just go crazy if they had to read all of that."
That has resulted in some dissenting voices in the mix, and a few responses to ProtoANZ's message opined that this was merely a natural and predictable evolution of Embark's approach.
In a message posted to X , however, Embark community and competitive operations lead Oscar Lundberg apologized for replacing the casters' voices with AI, saying it was a "mistake."

"We intended for Scotty and June to help bring more casual interest into The Finals esports ahead of TGM. That was the goal, but the work of our talent deserved to be included and highlighted, and it wasn’t," Lundberg wrote. "The video is down and won’t return in this form. The AMER and EMEA recaps planned in the same format won’t go out as planned either, and we’re rethinking all three."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Mv9w57D8JiQVz7d6Z4qd9P-1920-80.png
Embark expressed similar sentiments in a statement shared with IGN, saying that replacing caster voices with AI "wasn't the right call" and expressing gratitude for the "candid feedback."

But that didn't fly with the casters at the heart of the matter. "Embark saw no issue with this until they received overwhelming global backlash and even then their response was essentially, 'Whoopsie, we didn't think people would mind'," Bluepanda told the site. "It says to me that they're not really sorry at all. I'm done with the game and esports as a whole at this stage, the effort we put in and the amount of bullshit we have to deal with, especially in OCE, just isn't worth it anymore."

Calling the situation "a shit show," ProtoANZ called for the creation of an esports talent union to protect commentary and production teams: "We'll turn around and say, 'We're not doing this until people send us contracts that essentially ban the use of our voices in generative AI'."

content.v: Now that Rockstar's GTA 6 is available , people are discovering all manner of things in the game's gigantic open world . One such finding is that GTA 6 has its own take on Easter eggs, and Rockstar was quite literal.

Twitter user xGarbett posted a video of Jason climbing to the top of a cell tower where there is a bird's nest with eggs in it. Except these aren't normal eggs. They're painted to look like Easter eggs, and Jason can throw one of them (with an impressively tight spiral), sending it hurtling through the air until it crashes down on a scummy-sounding real estate agent or lawyer of some type.
xGarbett said in a follow-up post that it took about seven minutes to climb the tower, so unlocking this Easter egg will take some persistence.
Given the scale of GTA 6's world, there are no doubt going to be countless more Easter eggs that players discover as they make their way through Leonida.
Another secret that players have already discovered is that Bigfoot is back, and he's very smelly.

items.title: “我只希望 GTA 6 是同类游戏中的最后一款”：沃伦·斯佩克特 (Warren Spector) 祝贺 Rockstar 取得的里程碑式成就，但表示业界无法继续保持这种势头
items.summary: "I'd rather have hundreds of games and full employment than one game no matter how amazing it is."

content.v: Game industry legend Warren Spector retired in August , and somewhat ironically he's been more outspoken than ever about the state of the games industry. After blowing up over the closure of BioWare in October, he took a few weeks to think about it and got even more pissed off —and now he's shared some thoughts on the biggest videogame release of all time, Grand Theft Auto 6 .

Unlike the BioWare mess, Spector's not angry about GTA 6, but he's clearly ambivalent: His latest missive on LinkedIn opens with a congratulations to the dev team and says, "It looks like it will be a high point of sorts for our medium and our business," which right out of the gate suggests that he's not entirely upbeat about it.

Spector wasted no time getting to the point. "Its billion-dollar development cost and an undoubtedly crazy marketing budget don't represent a business model anyone else can or probably should emulate," he wrote. "That's especially true when thousands of developers are out of work. A billion dollars pays for a lot of games and a lot of salaries.
"Personally I'd rather have hundreds of games and full employment than one game no matter how amazing it is."

At the same time, he said GTA 6 demonstrates the truth of a point he's made previously: "Give a game the time and money to prove its potential (key word, potential) and you have a chance of making something great. Underfund a game or force it out the door before it's ready guaranteed failure no matter how much potential it has."

It's not hard to see that as a reflection on Thick as Thieves , the stealth game released earlier this year by Otherside Entertainment, where Spector served as chief creative officer and creative director prior to his retirement. Initially announced as a PvPvE game, Thick As Thieves was reworked and scaled back prior to its early access release, and eventually just ran out of money, time, and steam.

But it also characterizes the state of the game industry as a whole, where a select crop of proven winners—like GTA 6—from a tiny number of studios are given whatever resources they need to flourish, and everyone else scrabbles for crumbs. Former BioWare stalwart Trick Weekes predicted in September that Electronic Arts would be reduced to " guns and football " following its acquisition by Saudi Arabia's PIF, and so far he doesn't appear to be wrong .

In that light, Spector's ambivalence, and his conclusion, aren't hard to understand. "Again, congratulations. Ambition and innovation are necessary for the medium to reach its potential," he wrote. "I just hope GTA 6 is the last of its kind even if it's the best we have to offer."

items.title: 大脚怪回归 GTA 6，显然他闻起来令人作呕
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6 , it looks like Big

content.v: Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6 , it looks like Bigfoot is back and stinkier than ever. As the game steadily rolls out worldwide--or as people digitally immigrate to New Zealand for early access--streamers have been posting clips online of their encounters with the cryptid, and this time, it doesn't look like a man in a suit.

It looks like the Bigfoot sighting is tied to a mission in GTA 6, as the mysterious creature is wandering the woods of Leonida and it takes off in a panic when you encounter it. Another clip shows a strange encounter in the woods, with the player interacting with an effigy that emits noxious fumes and knocks them out. In a brief cutscene, Bigfoots, uh, really big feet, can be seen approaching Jason as he drifts in and out of consciousness.

In that first clip, Bigfoot is also covered in a cloud of fumes, which likely references stories about the mythical creature's potent stench. For GTA--and Red Dead Redemption--fans, this isn't the first time that they've been involved in a Bigfoot sighting, as encounters with it stretch back decades.

Back in 2004, rumors began to circulate about Bigfoot existing in GTA: San Andreas, but Rockstar dismissed these reports as false in 2005. A few years later, in Red Dead Redemption's Undead Nightmare expansion, protagonist John Marston was tasked with hunting down a pack of Sasquatches, and it was eventually revealed that the creatures were peaceful, capable of human speech, and now going extinct thanks to a certain trigger-happy cowboy.

Bigfoot would appear in GTA 5, as getting 100% completion in the game would unlock a new mission where co-protagonist Franklin hunts down a creature in Blaine Woods, only to discover it was a man in a costume . As an extra joke, the Bigfoot impersonator drops a few references to Red Dead Redemption's infamous encounter, but that doesn't mean the real Bigfoot isn't lurking in GTA 5. You could use the thermal scope on the sniper rifle supplied to you to spot a bipedal creature watching you during the "Predator" mission, and eating a golden Peyote plant under specific environmental conditions would turn players into Bigfoot.

Red Dead Redemption 2 brought an air of mystery back to the Bigfoot mythos, as you could find a gigantic skeleton half-buried in the snow high up on Mount Shann, and protagonist Arthur Morgan could also speak to an unseen figure that was heavily implied to be Bigfoot.
Meanwhile, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub for more details on how to make the most out of your trip to Vice City.

items.title: 如果游戏没有先碎成一千块的话，现在就快要和《GTA 5》模组说再见了
items.summary: I can't think of anything more appropriate.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
Well, it's almost time. The big day is upon us: Grand Theft Auto 6 is here.

I mean, not here . We don't have it. But over in consoleland my understanding is the masses are—as we speak—building some sort of life-partnership with their new husband/wife. Also, doing crimes. Also, shooting kneecaps .

Which means it's almost time to end this journey. I think we can all agree: my hyper-modded version of GTA 5 is, if anything, much better than whatever nonsense Rockstar has people doing over in Vice City. Does Vice City have Crazy Taxi ? Does Vice City have roving bands of cougars ? Does Vice City have, uh, banking ? I think not.

And since my quest is so clearly, definitively complete, it's time to say goodbye. Almost. We'll actually properly say goodbye tomorrow, but for now, I have installed Farewell Journey – A Goodbye to GTA 5 , which bills itself as "One last day in Los Santos before moving on to GTA 6".

It's mostly a series of goodbyes between Franklin and pals before he boards a plane, for some reason, to Vice City. Or it should be. With the state my copy of GTA 5 is in, it all gets a bit… harder to parse. Please enjoy, and I will see you back here tomorrow for our own final farewell.

items.title: 如何在 GTA 6 中获取安全代码
items.summary: Crack these vaults during a robbery to claim some cash.

content.v: GTA 6 safe codes will let you unlock sealed loot containers in the main story, but also during the lucrative robbery activity, which sees you knock over gang hideouts, banks, and other cash and contraband rich institutions.

The safe codes you need in the main story or specific missions are given to you, but in order to get a safe code during a robbery (and you'll need to because they're randomised), you have two main options:

First off, you can sometimes find the code written on something inside the store or bank, like a note on a board in the back office perhaps, or maybe a guard you've incapacitated is carrying it—press L3 and R3 to activate Focus Mode and help you find it.

You can also get the code by interrogating employees. Aim your weapon at them and use the "Threaten" or "Safe Code?" prompt shown on the screen to force them to give you the information. In certain robberies, this will also force cashiers to empty the register, as in previous GTA games.
Once you have the safe code, it will appear in the lower right corner of the screen when you're interacting with the safe. You'll have to enter the four-digit code to unlock it.

Time is of the essence, so the faster you can get the code, the quicker you can open the safe and load the cash into your bag. You can tell if an establishment has a safe by selecting it on your map, which will also give you some idea of the security level (low to high) and the approximate value of the goods, so you can pick a lucrative target for your next stick up.

items.title: GTA 6：最快的赚钱方法
items.summary: Sometimes the best thing a criminal can do is steal from other criminals.

content.v: There's a lot of ways to make money fast in GTA 6 , from robbing jewelry stores, pawn shops, and banks to boosting cars, winning races, and even mugging strangers. But some jobs are more lucrative than others, and sometimes the payoff of a big heist isn't worth the time, prep work, and violence it takes to complete them. If you need some cash fast and easy, here are some ideas that are mostly low risk, high reward. Heck, a couple of them aren't even illegal!
1. Rob other criminals
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AfT7Ty88gKDsUub2xbssGD-1920-80.jpg
Here's the best bit of advice you're going to get for making money in GTA 6: steal from your fellow thieves.

As you're out and about in the world, you'll often see a crime in progress: a bank robbery taking place, a jewelry store heist happening, an armored car being jacked, a drug deal down at the docks, or sometimes just a speeding vehicle filled with criminals fleeing from pursuing cops.

Hit those criminals. Hard and fast. And then take their shit . Especially in Chapter 2 and Chapter 3, another criminal's sack of bills or jewels or drugs is worth lots more than the take you'll get from hitting most robbery locations yourself. If you see crooks fleeing with duffel bags over their backs, drop 'em. (You can do it non-lethally if you like, but drop 'em.)

Then grab their bags and beat cheeks because the heat that was on them will quickly be on you. Some robbery crews will have multiple bags of goods, so best to travel as a couple, Lucia and Jason, if only to be able to carry off all that re-stolen loot and cash it in with a fence. You don't want to leave a sack of cash or jewelry behind, right? And if you act quickly enough, you'll be able to make a clean getaway.

When you're out exploring Leonida, keep your ears open at all times. Hear sirens? Alarms? Gunshots? Screams? Cars speeding or crashing? Don't hesitate. Take out the other crew and grab the loot for yourself. It's usually a great payday.
2. Steal cars
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/an5qCscgc9CwmyWVCooJ2D-1920-80.jpg

Okay, a pretty obvious one, but once you hit Chapter 2 and meet a mechanic, Moses, who gives you a slim jim and will buy stolen cars, it's probably the best way to turn a quick profit for relatively little risk. A decent car (Moses is looking for older model, low profile cars) will usually net you between one and a few thousand dollars, which is better than most smash-and-grab jobs you'll be doing at that stage and way easier to pull off. This is because Moses pays well and the fence you have in Chapter 2 does not.

The only drawback to Moses is that once he buys a stolen car, you can't sell him another for a bit. There's a big plus, though: he will often tell you precisely where the cars he's looking for are located. Randy, your car fence starting in Chapter 3, will pay way more because he's after higher end, much flashier cars.
3. Demolition Derby at Ambrosia Raceway
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zvDuuxmLCYLeFkh6tej3HD-1920-80.jpg

There are lots of races with nice payouts in GTA 6, but what if, like me, you're a terrible driver? The demolition races at Ambrosia Raceway are just the thing for those of you who tend to crash a lot anyway. Win on the oval track and you'll make over three grand, and it's double the take on the figure-eight track. Plus, you can repeat the races as many times as you like. Easy money.

The secret is, you come in first by default when all the other cars have been destroyed. If you can't beat 'em, just ram 'em, flip 'em, and destroy 'em. You don't even need to use your own wheels, just rent one from the track for a few hundred, spend a couple minutes slamming your front fender into everyone you see, and pocket the winnings long before you've done the eight laps.
4. Hunting
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RhvWHU4evhfwzJZHvrByED-1920-80.jpg

The hunting payouts aren't huge at first, but as you start taking on hunting missions for your old military buddy Bret in Lummox County in Chapter 2 (these missions are for Jason only), he'll request you hunt creatures that he'll pay more and more for. Like Red Dead Redemption 2, there are legendary animals in GTA 6, and that means money.

You can take down the animals from Bret's lists or just find your own prey out in the world. Just today I was exploring, spotted a large boar in the woods, grabbed my rifle from my truck, and shot it: Bret paid me $2,500 and even came to pick up the carcass himself, saving me a trip. For smaller trophies, just park outside and step into Bret's building, and he'll auto-buy the dead critters right out of your trunk. Good deal.
5. Robbing stores with back doors
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cJzBTfpfhiEthMEfnToL5D-1920-80.jpg

Your entire criminal strategy will change in Chapter 3 when you get a tool called the snap gun. This lets you pick door locks, which means bypassing alarms. From then on, make sure the places you want to rob have a back door: it's the key to turning a quick smash-and-grab into a proper heist.

Coming in the back of the store is the way to do crime: you get inside without anyone (usually) immediately noticing, can quickly and quietly subdue any security or employees hanging around in the rear of the store, get quick access to the security footage (destroy it) and the alarm system (disable it) and can locate the safe before anyone knows a heist is going down.

With alarms off and your partner doing crowd control, you can take the time to make sure you're getting every penny out of the place. Smash every jewelry display case. Threaten someone for the safe code or find it written down somewhere in the office. Empty all the cash drawers, even take people's wallets and the drugs from first-aid kits. Do it right and you can make a clean getaway, avoiding the police pursuit altogether. Beautiful.
6. Pilot Pete's drops
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2GkGGcCWCUK4SmBWAmWEHD-1920-80.jpg
You'll meet a pilot in Chapter 3 and he'll start offering you regular work in Chapter 4. Get in your flying practice, though: these are time-sensitive jobs.

Pete will direct you to his plane and you'll use it to distribute cocaine around Leonida by dropping packages to buyers waiting below. You'll have multiple targets to hit across the map, and a time-limit: those buyers won't hang around forever, waiting. (I guess they have something more important to do than acquiring huge bricks of coke?) Fly smart and plot your route efficiently and you'll make a nice chunk of change from each run.
Other money-makers
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WupBLNoLkWTWcyn8GQ3JbW-1920-80.jpg
There are, naturally, lots of other ways to make money, but most come with more risk, more time, or less of a haul.

items.title: 别指望在 GTA 6 中很长时间就能看到罪恶都市
items.summary: For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what

content.v: For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what the early hours will look like. Despite partially sharing a setting with GTA Vice City, you should not expect to be walking up the game's equivalent of Ocean Drive and Miami Beach in the opening minutes, as in the 2002 game. Far from it.

As we noted in our video discussion on why we gave GTA 6 a 10/10 in our review , Tamoor and Jake did some expectation-setting. Rather than starting the game in Vice City, you'll instead spend the opening hours in a smaller corner of the state of Leonida, Key Lento. Vice City is undoubtedly the crown jewel of the game's world, but it could be as much as 20 hours before you reach it, depending on how you play.

This seems to be a deliberate decision that, as Tam says, allows you to progress through the world at roughly the same pace as the ambitions of co-stars Lucia and Jason. The opening area may not be as glamorous as Vice City, but it is no less detailed than the rest of the game. It's possible it's only meant to last you around 5-6 hours, but we found it easy to get lost spending far more time than that, which resulted in Tam not reaching Vice City until after 15 or 16 hours.

Key Lento provides a good look at how the game and its simulation work, letting you eventually progress to a much larger space (seriously, the map is huge ) with a good understanding of how things work.
All of this is to say, the glitz and glamor of Vice City are waiting for you--eventually. To make the most of the opening hours, be sure to check out our guide on what to do in GTA 6 first .

items.title: 杰森喜欢 GTA 6 中的猫，但不是所有的猫
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world game with seemingly endless possibilities, GTA 6 does indeed let Jason express that love by petting cats he sees. However, not every cat is down to be pals with Jason.

As shared on social media, if you're walking around Leonida and spot a friendly-looking cat, you can go give it a pet. Jason even talks to the cat, because you'd have to be a monster not to, and the action even gives him a little focus boost.

But not all cats are the same. Another clip shared online shows Jason carjacking someone, as one does in GTA. After driving away, loud meowing can be heard, and the camera cuts to inside the car as a cat viciously attacks Jason. A quicktime event is necessary to get the cat to stop, at which point Jason is able to stop the car and let the cat out.

We can only imagine what would happen if that were a Rottweiler in the back seat of that car and not a sort-of-large cat. There are plenty of other animals to kill you while you're roaming Vice City and the rest of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6, and most of those would be less embarrassing to mention in your obituary than "cat."
Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most expansive and detailed games ever made, and if you're looking for some help, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub as well as our guide on what to do first .

In GameSpot's GTA 6 review , Tamoor Hussain said, "This game is the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach. GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I'd wager won't be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7," ultimately awarding it a 10/10 score .

items.title: 飞越整张 GTA 6 地图需要多长时间？
items.summary: The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive , gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its

content.v: The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive , gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its size accurately. Whether it's land, sea, or air, covering it is going to take a lot of time, but just how many hours should you set aside for a flight across Leonida?
We found out for ourselves by piloting a single-propeller plane across the map, which took us an entire four minutes and 10 seconds between the two points on the map. That's pretty big!

We've known for a while that the GTA 6 map was going to be big--with roughly more playable space than GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined --but even that claim doesn't put into perspective just how enormous the game truly is until you experience it for yourself. Another fascinating tidbit is that escaping GTA 6 is nigh-impossible , but definitely worth attempting.

As one streamer has discovered, if you try to cheese it on water using a jet ski, you'll run out of fuel and be left stranded in the water. There might be a happy ending to this scenario, as some streamers have posted clips of a dog on a wave runner coming to their rescue. We've tried to replicate this ourselves, but we've had no luck yet.

But if you choose to stay within Leonida's invisible boundaries, you won't run out of things to do for quite some time. Between missions to improve your lot in life, pursue relationship goals, and soak up the scenery, the reactive open world of GTA 6 will keep you entertained for hours. Our GTA 6 review gave the game a rare 10/10 score, and dozens of other reviewers worldwide have also been very impressed with what Rockstar Games has achieved.

You can experience all of that for yourself soon, and if you're not planning to do some digital tourism with a long walk, check out our GTA 6 guides hub for all kinds of walkthroughs to help you survive and thrive in the game.

others.title: IGN：《GTA6》无法重玩主线剧情！提供15个存档位

content.v: 《GTA6》没有设置剧情任务专用重玩菜单。完成任务后，玩家无法从独立界面直接再次启动，只能提前保留进度，之后载入相应存档重走剧情。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261118/1795013601_328871_jpg_r.jpg
这一设计与游戏的任务结构及世界状态变化有关。玩家的选择可能产生不同结果，同一情境既可能平稳推进，也可能演变为混乱局面， 开放世界 中的随机事件同样会受到此前选择影响。
任务进度、选择结果和持续变化的世界状态相互关联，简单的重玩选项难以精确还原玩家首次执行任务时的全部条件。因此，本作缺少的是便捷的任务重玩菜单，并非完全无法返回旧任务。
游戏最多允许建立15个手动存档槽。想补看不同分支、重试任务或保留关键剧情节点的玩家，需要在推进流程时轮换存档，再载入对应阶段。不过，这种方式要求提前规划，也无法像标准任务选择界面一样随时访问所有关卡。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 老黄出轨后 G胖和女粉丝合照被翻！你也要沦陷了？

content.v: 三个月前，转转给5090DV2显卡报了13500元的回收价，差点被网友上门核销户口簿。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030567554.jpg
而三个月后，他们大概也想不到，这13500的劲爆低价，就已经跟不上版本了。
如今向我们走来的，是给同款显卡报价1500的大肥鱼大人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030578345.jpg
而在大肥鱼之后，还有隐居废品回收站多年的情感专家。
他们在仔细评估5090显卡的情感状态后，又一次打破行业认知，给出了50元包邮的低价承诺。
......显卡界，或许真的要变天了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030565139.jpg
显卡界，或许真的要吃大辩了
当然，前头的两张超低报价图，明眼人都能看出来是AI的杰作。
放在平时，但凡有人敢制作这种假图，那是要进赛博监狱陪转转一起捡肥皂的。
但如今，这些梗图作者赶上了“好时候”，赛博狱警们光顾着看国际新闻，根本没工夫管其他。
至于是什么国际新闻？大伙心里想必有数——英伟达的首席执行官黄仁勋，他在出轨之后辞职了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030564732.jpg
说实话，作为大伙口中的“卖显卡的老黄”，黄仁勋已经给英伟达掌舵33年。
在此期间，大伙也想过老黄可能会在某一天离开，但真没想过老黄是以这种方式离开......
别说是我了，哪怕是想象力丰富的网友们，在此之前也没想过11月份竟会如此劲爆。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030563986.jpg
只能说，从“老黄出轨”到“老黄辞职”之间的事态发展，实在是过于迅速了。
我这边过场动画还没加载完，那边就已经把老黄打出三阶段，还光速清空了血条，根本不给人反应时间。
德国当初打闪电战，也没闪得这么快啊？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030565529.jpg
但国内网友已经给老黄选好饮料了
当然，在感慨事态之余，咱们这里还是先梳理一下整起事件的脉络。
这一揽子事的起因，是10月29日的时候，《纽约时报》发布的一篇报道。
在其中，他们表示黄仁勋跟一位外国的数据中心高管亲密无间。
然后到了11月8日，英伟达官网对此做出回应，表示他们已经启动了对黄仁勋的审查。
老黄本人也完全支持和配合。
老黄支持和配合的初步结果，是当天的英伟达官网出现了第二则声明。
这则声明是老黄本人的道歉信，其中的老黄承认自己出轨，并向家人和员工报以歉意。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030565913.jpg
在老黄的道歉信后，国内外网友的态度基本是炸锅了。
虽说外网科技巨鳄出轨这种事，大伙早就见怪不怪，以至于能轻松绷住。
但当这种事和大伙熟悉的“显卡老黄”结合，玩家们依旧忍不住产生了浓浓的吃瓜情绪。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030565548.jpg
国内外有些网友，开始就此联想资本阴谋论，认为老黄是被人做局了。
也有网友从“皮衣”“薪水很高”等方面展开联想，推测老黄是被保护伞公司设计陷害。
还有贴吧老哥根据“T1淘汰赛出局”“T1和老黄合影”等信息，提出新的玄学假设。
——可能是有人对T1的照片下蛊做法，结果无意识地波及了老黄。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030566797.jpg
而在各种猜测日益泛滥之时，《纽约时报》在11月12日又爆出了新料子。
这次他们援引5位英伟达内部人士的消息，表示老黄还和一位英伟达女高管有染。
......只能说还得是《纽约时报》啊，直接把老黄打进二阶段了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030565184.jpg
关键输出全是《纽约时报》打的
到了这个时候，由于“老黄爱好广泛”这点基本已是事实，网络上的风向，大都转变为探讨老黄会不会被卸任？下一任英伟达CEO又会是谁？
那时候还有网友毛遂自荐，表示自己有充足的“不会出轨”证明，能够担此重任。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030566706.jpg
不过随着12日当晚英伟达官方宣布老黄辞职，同时由柯莱特·克雷斯出任临时CEO，网上的这些讨论也暂时失去了意义。
咱们此时还能说什么呢？
......大概只能说在显卡市场吃大辩之前，卖显卡的老黄要先去吃大辩了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/users/2026/11/17/origin_202611172030575416.jpg
当然，老黄的这次事件除了对显卡市场造成影响，对咱们PC玩家天天念叨的Steam......其实也造成了一些影响。
——继卖显卡的老黄出事后，卖游戏的G胖也被所谓的“特殊人士”盯上了。
G胖（Gabe Newell），Steam创始人
这件事发生在老黄承认出轨之后。
一位西班牙老哥搬出了G胖和国内女粉丝的合影，在调侃之余，将噩耗带给了外网的Steam玩家。
在合影中，G胖配合着女粉丝比了个心。
搭配老黄事件的滤镜，就有种G胖下一秒要含泪辞职，被FBI带去调查的悲壮感。

items.title: 一只鸭子机器人，让我突然看懂了本地AI
items.summary: 距离NVIDIA的RTX Spark上市，已经过去33天。 此前的文章 里，我已经简单聊过它的性能表现。但在那之后，一个问题反而一直留在我脑子里： 我们到底需要用本地部署的AI模型来做什么？ 和云端大模型相比，本地模型的

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/94519a3396ad47698148bf62f627f318.jpg_mw680water
距离NVIDIA的RTX Spark上市，已经过去33天。 此前的文章 里，我已经简单聊过它的性能表现。但在那之后，一个问题反而一直留在我脑子里：
我们到底需要用本地部署的AI模型来做什么？
和云端大模型相比，本地模型的优势其实已经不新鲜了——隐私得到保护，使用不依赖网络，也不需要每次调用都付出额外的API成本。但这些优势似乎还不足以成为普通人非本地模型不可的理由。
直到上周，我去了一趟上海英伟达办公室。现场用多台RTX Spark笔记本电脑和RTX Spark 紧凑型桌面主机（SFF），部署本地模型并展示了多个落地Demo，让我意识到本地AI的价值不是替代云端大模型，而是让AI向我们的日常生活再走一步。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/7054a7710d7bd4cfa593d50f62ab209e.jpg_mw680water
我们在现场看到了华硕和机械革命的两款RTX Spark紧凑型桌面主机
先说说游戏吧。现场展示的几款游戏中，《伊莫》对本地模型的应用给我的印象最深。
这项功能放在了《伊莫》的家园系统里，玩家可以通过语音指令，和自己放在家园里小伊莫进行互动，命令他们去种植作物、建造设施、或是完成挖矿浇水这样的简单工作。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/a3b4b5572bedee6c284e59ea51420957.jpg_mw680water
这些事情看起来并不复杂，但恰恰因为任务范围有限，一个本地小模型就足以支撑这样的交互。玩家说一句话，伊莫就可以根据指令做出对应动作，也可以通过动作和表情回应玩家。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/01fbae018b577fde22556d9154b95538.jpg_mw680water
还可以让它们到你眼前集合，分别“表演才艺”
从技术角度看，这或许只是一个并不复杂的AI应用；但从玩家体验来说，它提供的是一种很直接的“情绪价值”——游戏里的伙伴开始真正听懂你，并且可以为你分担一些琐碎操作了。
这和几年前大模型刚出现时很像。
一开始，我们也会问“AI到底能拿来干什么？”。但现在，人们已经在写作、搜索、办公、编程等使用场景中离不开AI了。本地AI也许同样正处在这样一个阶段——技术已经准备好了，只是我们还没有养成对应的使用习惯。
当本地模型不再被限制在“小伊莫”这样的游戏角色里，它其实还能做更多事情。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/0913c7dd045169051f6c87af379a507e.jpg_mw680water
由“特效小哥”团队带来了机器人Demo
现场的创作者中有人提到，他已经在用本地模型批量完成照片的基础调色工作；对于像我这样经常采访录音的人来说，也会通过本地模型对录音文件进行转写、整理和关键词分类。
但真正给我带来启发的，是现场的一个机器人Demo。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/92487831cf900e36f7852564acb54695.jpg_mw680water
Microduck是Hugging Face今年推出的一个开源机器人。它能走路、踢球、滑行，摔倒后还能自己重新站起来，也可以通过强化学习训练新的动作。
在现场，这只鸭子的“大脑”并不在机器人身体里，而是放在旁边的一台RTX Spark笔记本里。通过Wifi网络，机器人把数据传回来，本地模型负责处理和整理，最终让机器人动起来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/ae2072dbf194108a2396b9287833926e.gif_mw680
这个过程最有意思的地方在于，它并没有要求使用者先成为机器人专家。
现场的一位工作人员告诉我，直到几天前他也不了解机器人该怎么玩，对机器人的电机等专业知识更是毫无了解。但他通过搭建工作流，让本地小模型负责采集整理数据、大模型来分析并下达指令，给自己搭建出了一套“从零开始玩转机器人”的流程。
这可能才是本地AI最值得关注的地方。我之前思考的，都是本地模型能放进哪些已有的生活场景里，但是在它的帮助下，我们其实能创造更多使用它的生活场景。比如在现场，还有另一个团队带来了一套教学授课的机械臂学习方案，同样依托于本地模型实现。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/1e91fa3f7a78ccd7cf3b8b3785ea5dd1.jpg_mw680water
所以现在回头看，我觉得我们讨论本地AI时，或许不应该一直纠结“它能跑多大的模型”，反而应该多去想想怎样让它适配到更多生活场景里。
云端大模型更像一个擅长思考的大脑，处理复杂的问题、进行长链路推理、帮助我们制定计划。而本地小模型更像是与外界接触的“神经末梢”，它负责听见、看见、感知周围的变化，处理那些不值得专门“问一次大模型”的琐碎任务。
我们已经学会了把AI当做一颗外置大脑，随着RTX Spark这样的设备逐渐普及，它们对本地模型的支持，也一定会让我们逐渐学会把AI当做另一只手臂，去触摸那些我们现在还未想象过的生活。

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/784426b41c4ae13053aefadb64cce717.jpg_mw680water
电影院除了放电影，还能干什么？
11月14日晚，2026年王者荣耀KPL年度总决赛第五局，此时JDG与WB战至2比2平，意味着谁先拿下这局，谁就抢先一步拿到赛点。
比赛进行到大概12分钟，此时JDG已经落后近7k经济，只能放任WB进入己方蓝区，并退至二塔龟缩防守。关键时刻，JDG游走位无畏的赵怀真抓住机会，闪现拉住对方双C，中路清融的不知火舞立刻闪现跟进开团，最终在大劣的局势下打出了一记漂亮的反击。
伴随着解说的惊叹，耳边响起的是吼声和此起彼伏的尖叫。这些声音，一部分来自音响，那是比赛现场观众的欢呼声：另一部分则来自我身旁的座位，甚至有人站起身挥动双手呐喊助威。一时之间，我几乎无法分辨声音出自哪边。
此时，我正坐在深圳儒意电影旗下的一家寰映影城中，与KPL年度总决赛的举办场地成都凤凰山体育公园综合体育馆是字面意义上的千里迢迢。但是，面对眼前的巨大幕布，听到身边观众热烈地讨论比赛、尽情呐喊尖叫，我时不时还是会产生自己身处现场的错觉。
不得不说，这可能是我至今在电影院这个场合所感受过的最“热闹”、也最激动人心的一次“观影经历”了。
今年是KPL创立的第十年，举办场地选在了《王者荣耀》的诞生地成都。
但是，能够“线下”观看这场比赛的机会其实不止在成都 。今年儒意电影也与KPL开启了“十年荣耀，顶峰相见”全域跨界联动，总决赛当晚，儒意电影在旗下全国50家影城开设了官方第二现场，让玩家能够在影院的大屏下集体观赛、线下助威。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/7bda2068bdb8bbddadc45a2aedd03acb.jpg_mw680water
也正是在这其中的一家影院，我和满场玩家一同观赛，看着JDG与WB打满七局，最后WB以4:3获胜，拿下队史第四个冠军。
整场观赛过程中，最先让我感到好奇的是我右手边的一位男生。相比其他人，他总表现得稍稍沉默，也更克制，少有呼喊出声的时候，他另一边的男生，还时不时转过头来，向他解释不同的选手各有什么特征，双方队伍又擅长怎样的战术体系。
好奇之下自然是一番攀谈，我这才知道，他们一行共五人是大学同学，又因为大多自小接触《王者荣耀》，便因为游戏结成关系更紧密的“固排搭子”。他本身其实看KPL不多，对战队、选手也不是很熟悉，但他旁边的另一位男生是KPL的忠实观众，既然有人提出要来影院线下观赛，大伙就都一起来了。而在BP博弈、或是战况激烈的时刻，那位男生也总不忘向他讲解：“这个选手总是这样……”
至于为什么不去现场而是选择影院，另一位男生有点不好意思地告诉我，飞去成都观赛的成本确实有点高，不是大家都负担得起，反倒是在影院，大家可以随便相约，“看完一起回宿舍”。
当然，也有很多玩家，是怀着更为复杂的情绪来到影院观赛。
影院的最后一排有一对观众，我本以为是一同前来观赛的情侣，结果询问后才知道，他们其是表兄妹的关系，表妹2024年才开始接触《王者荣耀》，当时被研究生同学一起拉着开始看KPL，结果迅速发展为她繁忙学业中的重要消遣活动。
聊起KPL，她几乎是滔滔不绝地向我描述起她最喜欢的“狼队”，从最开始被实力圈粉，一路追过的大小比赛，甚至于去年鸟巢线下观看狼队和AG的总决赛——也正是因为去年的那场比赛，狼队最终2：4遗憾输给AG，导致她觉得又难过又“亏”。今年的KPL总决赛没有狼队，她又割舍不下自己的电竞情怀，干脆拉着同样玩王者的表哥一起来影院观赛。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/8835c51ba0e80a778065da272faf074e.jpg_mw680water
去年KPL总决赛在鸟巢举办
不同人来到影院观看KPL的原因各不相同。比如我碰到一对Coser打扮的女生，她们因为扩列认识，其中一位明年就要出国读书，决定今年来线下看一次KPL；另一位女生已经将近3年没玩过《王者荣耀》，却是KPL的忠实观众，同时是JDG选手清融的铁粉，第六局比赛JDG取胜，把比分扳成3：3平，她一边尖叫一边看着手表捂嘴：“我心跳都130了！”
我想，不论什么理由，当所有人同处影厅，同时被幕布上的赛事牵动着心思时，不论成都或深圳，不论现场或是“第二现场”，大家的情绪是共通的。
自2016年创立以来，KPL一直是移动电竞圈层标杆级的职业联赛。赛事规格不断升级、社会认可度不断提高的同时，玩家之间的凝聚力也在同步增长。能够汇集如此多的玩家在电影院观赛，也说明了KPL不止是为玩家贡献共同的话题，也实打实地把更多玩家聚到一起，产生更紧密的联系。
比赛结束，影院散场时，我在不少观众那看到本次KPL的联名周边——这次儒意电影和KPL展开合作，不仅是决赛夜的观战，早在国庆期间，北京、上海、广州、深圳、成都、杭州六座城市的六家影城已经陆续换上了KPL主题“皮肤”， 联名内容出现在儒意电影全国700多家直营影城的映前广告和大屏上，各类联名周边则直接摆进影城柜台出售。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/6e6aa3f50857bab956215e4d037d9247.png_mw680water
和线上观赛相比，他们切实地留下了一些物件。在直播间关闭后，一张票根，或是某个亚克力挂件，会被他们带回家。今后看到，或是摸到这些东西时，可能还会回想起这个在影院度过的热烈的决赛夜。
根据儒意电影公布的数据，这次联动为万达影城APP及小程序带来了约45万新增用户；仅国庆假日期间，联名商品就卖出了100多万件，活动曝光量超过2亿次。这些数字背后，有不少人可能是第一次因为看电影以外的理由走进影院。
但对儒意电影来说，赛事直播其实并不是新业务。
2025年5月底，F1西班牙大奖赛在全国6城6家IMAX影院直播，北京万达影城CBD万达广场店是其中之一，这也是全球首场在IMAX影院直播的F1赛事。英雄联盟LPL总决赛已经连续几年登上大银幕，今年影院场次排在凌晨，票依然难抢。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/a7b11c4b6a1a84c4e57d639272e63bd7.png_mw680water
归根结底，赛事内容自带仪式感和情感共鸣，放到公共空间里，这些感受也会被放大。观众来到现场，追求的不仅是赛事内容本身，还有“同好聚会”的体验。
当然，如果仅凭各类赛事，那么能够服务的观众数量依然有限，很难形成稳定的内容供给。或许是察觉到这一点，儒意电影今年也开始把各种零散的尝试变成体系，搭建一套自有的内容矩阵。 这里说的"自有"，不是指每一份内容都由自己生产。关键在于运营能力：选什么内容、怎么排场、在影厅里怎么呈现，这些由影院自己掌握。
首先要变的是供给逻辑。今年6月的战略发布会上，儒意影视提出“全球内容开放合作模式”，从“供给驱动”转向“供给+需求驱动”，院线全年拿出10%到20%的排片做多元化放映，最直观的例子便是其4月推出的“拼好片”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/344b9410865aacb42d23a494fa78eb94.png_mw680water
顾名思义，“拼好片”就是用户投票"许愿"，儒意电影按行业规则引入片源，拼团成功后排场放映。官方的说法是，要“在某一座城市、某一个时间点，为共同喜爱某一部影片的那些观众完成一场放映”。到今年9月，6部由全国用户票选出的电影已经正式通过这一模式登上大银幕。

内容品类也在这个过程中被补全，拼凑出这张“自有内容矩阵”的大致轮廓：剧集方面，《黑夜告白》通过"拼好片"在十座城市做了直播连线见面会，活动上线12小时就有20万用户预约；综艺方面，影院落地了《歌手》直播现场；动漫方面，其8月和腾讯视频合办的动漫大赏在北京、上海、广州、成都等10个城市放映了100多场，平均上座率达到九成；晚会方面，9月20日的"湾区升明月"2026大湾区电影音乐晚会，儒意电影是独家影院第二现场，没能去到现场的观众坐在自己城市的影厅里，跟着屏幕应援、合唱……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/b5503f1e621f830beb92f32c2399fab1.jpg_mw680water
游戏联动如今是相对成熟的一块。其专门搭建的IP内容池“游戏联运池”目标是将影院打造成玩家的第二现场，过去两年已合作过《王者荣耀》《原神》《恋与深空》《光与夜之恋》《第五人格》《鸣潮》等多款游戏，据称带来了300万25岁以下的新客群。
内容形态在改变，影厅的角色也跟着变。过去影厅只负责“播片”，放完观众就离场；现在影城还要配套做周边、布置主题场景、组织应援和互动。像儒意电影今年提出的“新五感”体验标准中，“社交感”就是通过同好互换、观赛活动、动漫市集等，“让陌生人因热爱而相聚”。
影城大堂的变化则更加直观。儒意电影投资的潮玩品牌52TOYS已经进驻旗下402家国内影城，货架上既有自研潮玩IP，也有各类联名盲盒；智能大头贴"拍立方"则落地了305家影城，尝试先用拍照打卡把观众吸引过来，再往观影上转化。
今年6月推出的“六星影城”进一步把这些元素集中到一起，官方定位是"先锋、稀缺、独特体验"的城市潮流文化地标。“六星影城”中包括IMAX珍稀海报展墙、时光里潮流集成店和IP联名打卡区。到今年第三季度，全国已有30家六星影城挂牌，覆盖27座重点城市。官方披露的品牌净推荐值达87%，年复购率超过56.8%。
沿着这条路往下走，大众对于“电影院”的固有印象或许也会松动：在未来，电影院可能成为一个不去看电影，反倒为了与人相会的地方。
结语
回想起在电影院观看2026 KPL决赛的夜晚，我还能想起很多与KPL关系不大的事情。有个女生零食买了太多吃不完，问我要不要分点；那个看起来有点沉默的男生告诉我，除了陪朋友玩王者，他在《影之刃零》发售第三天就通了关，最近刚结束二周目；还有那位表哥，现场掏出自己的NS2，说前段时间刚玩完塞尔达“王泪”，现在往前补上旷野之息。
我想，这场比赛之后，还会有更多各种各样的人走进这个影厅，凑在一起谈天说地。他们相聚的契机、各自的喜好或许不同，但可以肯定的是，彼此的距离被影厅切实地拉近了。
以影城为据点，以社交为纽带，不难发现儒意电影正在构建一套全新的文娱生态架构。放眼将来，电影院或将重新定义一代年轻人的文化娱乐生活。

items.title: 终末地斩获Google Play双料大奖：鹰角的“逆周期”之作，再次迎来回响
